observed.name: babe_primary_probability_denominator
observed.quote: | `babe_primary_probability_denominator` | 50 | ratio-denominator |  | BABE primary-slot probability c = 1/N, where a validator's per-slot win chance is p = 1 - (1 - c)^theta (theta = stake fraction). This is the fork-rate dial: AllowedSlots is PrimaryAndSecondaryVRFSlots, which already guarantees exactly one secondary author per slot, so every primary winner is an ADDITIONAL author — i.e. a fork. At the previous 1/4 with 5 equal-stake authorities ~20% of slots forked (~12/min at 1 s blocks; devnet measured 4.7 reorgs/min/node), which was the common root of the 2026-07-25 stalls: deep reorgs, finality landing off a node's best branch, block-request churn, reputation bans, validator isolation. 1/50 gives ~1.6% — a ~12x reduction. Costs nothing in randomness: pallet_babe deposits epoch randomness from any VRF-carrying pre-digest and SecondaryVRFSlots blocks carry one, so the beacon seeding the PoI committee sampler is fed by every block regardless of c. |
